chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Palkhaktheih thute hong pai hamtang ding a, ahi zongin tuate hong tun nading kizang mi ahihleh a dahhuaizia!
Hih naupangnote khat a khialh nadingin a bawl sangin a ngawng ah an-gawina suang ki-oksak henla tuipi sungah kikhiasuk hileh ama' ading hoihzaw lai ding hi.
Note kidawm un! Na sanggampa a khialh leh taai unla a kisik leh maisak un.
No' tungah ni khatin sagihvei hong khial henla sagihvei mah 'Ka kisik hi,' hong cih leh na maisak uh kul ding hi."
Sawltakte in Topa' kiangah, "Ka upna uh hong khangsak in," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in hih bangin gen hi: "Ankamtang bang upna na neih uhleh hih bokthok kunga kiangah, 'Kizunglot inla tuipi sungah va po in,' na ci thei ding uh a, na cih bang uh hong mang ding hi.
"Note lakah kua in a silapa, lokuan ahi-a tuucing ahi zongin gamlak pan hong ciah ciangin, 'Hong pai inla ankuang hong uum pah in,' ci ding ahi hiam?
Ci lo-in, 'Ka nitak an ding na thuk in. Tua ciangin kithawi inla ka nek ka dawn sung hong vil in. Tua nungah na ne na dawn thei ding hi,' cizaw ding hilo hiam?
A kisawl teng a sep manin silapa' tungah lungdam ci ahi hiam?
Note zong hong kisawl teng na sep khit uh ciangin, 'I vaipuak bek mah a sem zo i hi a, sila simtaaklote i hi lel hi,' ci un."
Jerusalem lam a zuatna ah Jesu in Samaria gam leh Galilee gam kikal dung nawk hi.
Khuaneu khat a lut ding laitak vun natna vei mi sawm, a gamla ah dingin Jesu dawntuah uh hi.
A aw uh sangkhanin, "Jesu aw, Topa aw, kote hong khual in," ci uh hi.
Tua mite Jesu in a muh ciangin, "Pai unla siampite kiangah va kilak un," ci hi. Amaute a pai kawmun sianthona ngah uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' lakah khat, a dam lam a kitheih ciangin awging lianpi tawh Pasian phat kawmin kilehkik a,
Jesu' khe-phung ah boksukin lungdam ko hi. Tua mipa pen Samaria mi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Mi sawm kisiangsak hilo hiam? Mi kuate koi ah om uh hiam?
Hih tualpua midangpa losiah kilehkik-a Pasian a phat kuamah om lo ahi hiam?" ci hi
A cih khit ciangin tua mipa' kiangah, "Tho inla ciah in. Na upna in hong damsak khinzo hi," ci hi.
Pasian' kumpigam cik ciangin hong tung ding cih Pharisee-te in dong uh ahih manin Jesu in, "Pasian' kumpigam pen ettheih muhtheih namin hong tung lo ding a,
Hih takah om!' ahihkeileh 'Hua takah om!' zong hong kici lo ding hi. A hang pen, en un, Pasian' kumpigam pen note' lakah om hi," ci-in dawng hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite' kiangah zong hih bangin ci hi: "Mihing' Tapa' hunlenite khat beek muh ding na lunggulh hun uh hong tung ding a, ahi zongin na mukha kei ding uh hi.
Mite in, 'Hih takah om!' ahihkeileh 'Huah om!' hong ci ding uh a, ahi zongin pusuak kei unla amaute zui kei un.
A hang pen khuaphialep taangzaihin vankuum a mong khat pan a mong khat dong a taan mah bangin Mihing' Tapa zong ama' ni ciangin tua bang hiding hi.
Ahi zongin amah in gimna tampi thuak masa ding a, hih khangmite in amah nolh ding uh hi.
Mihing' Tapa' hun ciangin zong Noah' hun lai dan mah hiding hi.
Tembaw sungah Noah a lut ni dongin mite anne tuidawnin mo kipi kikha uh a, tua ciangin tuicin tungin amaute a vekun si uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Lot' huna piang dan mah, mite anne tuidawnin sumlei sumzuakin lokho innlamin om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Sodom pan Lot a paikhiat ni-in vantung pan mei leh kaat zusuk a, amaute a vekun susia hi.
Mihing' Tapa hong kilaak ni ciangin zong tua dan mah hiding hi.
Tua ni ciangin innkhumd tunga omte in inn sunga om a vante uh a la dingin kumsuk kei ta uh hen. Tua mah bangin lo sunga omte zong ciah nawn kei ta uh hen.
Lot' zi thu phawk un.
Ama' nuntakna a hu nuam mi in tua nuntakna taan ding a, ahih hangin ama' nuntakna a taan mi in tua nuntakna kemsuak ding hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah tua zan ciangin lupna khat tungah mi nih om ding a, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi.
An-gawikhawm numei nih om ding a, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."
(Lo ah mi nih om ding a, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi.)e
Tua ciangin nungzuite in, "Topa, koi tak hiding hiam?" a cih uh ciangin Jesu in, "Siluangpum omna peuh ah musanete kikhawm ding hi," ci-in dawng hi.A Kuhkal Meigongnu Thugenteh
